text:
Maria Patel: Hey team, the Zenith POC is seeing their web client throw JSON parse errors intermittently when using our streaming API. They say the stream disconnects mid-payload and the last chunk is a partial JSON object.
Alex Kim: ugh. Do we have the request id or example?
Maria Patel: customer provided a capture, session id=zn-84321. Error: 'Unexpected end of JSON input' from their browser. They see multiple SSE events that look truncated.
Jordan Lee: can you paste the raw bytes? often this is chunked/encoding level.
Maria Patel: pasted below (they redacted user text):
```
data: {"id":"msg_123","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hello, here's a table:\n"}}},
data: {"id":"msg_123","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"|col1|col2|\n"}}],"done":true}
```
Maria Patel: you can see the second line is missing a closing brace before the final event.
Samir Gupta: looks like an upstream connection closed while writing. Could be ALB/NGINX timeout, or our frontend dropping the chunk. Any gateway logs for zn-84321?
DeployBot: [deploy] routed request zn-84321 to model-node-17 at 2026-09-04T15:02:11Z
Alex Kim: also check for double buffering in the customer's client. Some HTTP libs reassemble incorrectly when SSE is split across TCP segments. But we should avoid creating partial JSON pieces in a single event.
Jordan Lee: I pulled the proxy logs: ALB closed idle connection after 60s with code 504 for that stream. That matches timing. If the model takes longer between tokens, ALB might cut and the client sees a truncated last event.
Maria Patel: customer says the issue happens even when responses are <60s.
Samir Gupta: hmm. Could be intermediate CDN or corporate reverse proxy doing aggressive timeouts. Ask them to curl from a machine outside corp network: `curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams ...` and capture raw output.
Maria Patel: asked them to run curl test and send output. Also asked for browser console network HAR.
Alex Kim: parallel thought — are we sending SSE keepalive comments? We add `: keepalive\n\n` every 15s. If something strips lines starting with `:` the parser might join chunks weirdly.
Jordan Lee: we do send `: ping` comments. But proxies shouldn't strip leading colon lines. Still, let's instrument the stream: add a header `x-rw-debug: zn-84321` and a sequence number on each event from the runtime so we can see where it stopped. Samir, can you enable a temporary tracing flag on the route?
Samir Gupta: on it. I'll enable `stream-debug:true` for the customer route for 1h and post logs here.
DeployBot: [trace] stream-debug enabled for route id r-90321 by samir at 2026-09-04T15:12:03Z
Maria Patel: customer asked if Dedicated capacity would avoid this — they think rate limits are causing mid-stream drops.
Alex Kim: Dedicated reduces noisy neighbor throttling but won't change behavior for middlebox timeouts. Worth offering a short Dedicated trial for the POC if they suspect general throttling. Also confirm they aren't hitting our per-connection duration limits.
Jordan Lee: I pulled agent runtime logs around zn-84321: the runtime flushed a partial event when the model process crashed with OOM at token 412. That's a real cause here — model process died, so stream ended without closing the JSON.
Maria Patel: oh wow. customer reported no errors on their side.
Samir Gupta: the crash was due to a priming prompt that ballooned memory. Patch pushed to runtime to reject >12k token priming for this plan.
Alex Kim: can we surface a clearer error to client when backend dies mid-stream? Right now it's silent.
Jordan Lee: yes, we can emit a final `event: error\ndata: {"type":"server_shutdown","reason":"oom"}\n\n` before closing, but only if the runtime can intercept. In oom it might be hard. We'll add watchdog to catch process exit and send a shim close event from the proxy.
Maria Patel: customer also wants exact repro steps so they can test locally. Can we share a minimal curl + small script that simulates truncation?
Samir Gupta: I'll add a gist but for now: `printf \"data: {\\\"a\\\":1\\n\"; sleep 1; printf \"data: {\\\"b\\\":2\\n\"` piped into a netcat listener emulates it.
Alex Kim: good. Also asked infra to increase model node oom logs retention for the POC.
DeployBot: [note] increased node log retention for node-17 by 24h
Maria Patel: update for customer: we found two likely causes — (1) model process OOM causing abrupt close (we've patched and added tracing), and (2) possible corporate proxy timeouts. Would you be willing to try again from an external network? If both still fail, we'll spin up a short Dedicated trial and enable `stream-debug`.
Customer (quoted by Maria Patel): happy to test from home network tomorrow, wants Dedicated pricing for 2-week POC.
Alex Kim: Sales: for a 2-week Dedicated eval, propose a $3k credit and temporary reservation on a single gpu-pool, subject to capacity. Maria, can you send terms?
Maria Patel: will draft terms and include support hours.
Jordan Lee: follow-ups for engineers: 1) add watchdog shim to emit server_shutdown event on process exit; 2) keep `x-rw-debug` traces for the session; 3) verify keepalive comment behavior through common CDNs.
Samir Gupta: filed a short ticket RW-STREAM-612 and linked the debug logs.
Maria Patel: thanks everyone. I'll update the customer after their curl from home. :thumbsup:
Alex Kim: thanks, keep me in loop.
Maria Patel: closing thread once customer confirms. :pray:
